text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Kawakami 
Princess was even more fired up than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it is time for the Summer 
Training Camp episode! In other words, you 
understand what that means, right!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That means we've reached the halfway mark 
of our story! To head into the next 
chapter, we're gonna have to train our 
bodies like craaaazy!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"With the Yushun Himba behind us on the 
Tiara route, only the Shuka Sho remains. 
And serving as the grand finale of my 
Classic year will be..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A battle to decide the princess of 
princesses, the best of them all. It can 
only be the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
choice_data_list: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup, huh...

text_block_list.text:
That was a GⅠ race we had observed 
together before. It was a race where not 
only Classic-tier but also Senior-tier 
Umamusume crossed paths to battle for the 
queen's throne.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the brilliance of the Triple Tiara, 
it's a fierce showdown between queens old 
and new to decide this year's ultimate 
Queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I believe this race is truly fitting to 
prove that I am a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"And just like PreFie, I shall receive 
everyone's blessings!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—The cheers and applause become a crown of 
hope, and light overflows from my body as 
I wear it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The final showdown with the Dark Princess 
is finally upon us. Taking the hand of the 
legendary Trainer... her Prince, she 
unleashes her new ultimate move: Minna no 
Ultra Light!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And into the movie-scale battle racing 
across the cosmos...!
choice_data_list:
……Aren't we supposed to be talking about 
the favorites?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... But I think it's a race I can't 
miss if I want to become a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Losing is simply out of the question! If 
we're going to do this, we must take first 
place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am the princess! I shall knock 
down every single enemy in my path!!"
choice_data_list:
Then I've got to work hard on training 
too.

Then I need to work hard on training too, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! So, what should we start with!?
choice_data_list: Crossing the ocean on sheer guts

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is the latest episode of 
'Mu-Mu-Muscle! Pretty Cure'! The 
hot-blooded training episode where she 
hones her kicking power to subdue a 
rampaging water dragon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ei, yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! Someone's already here?! 
Punching with all their might toward the 
waterfall basin...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was you, Akebono-san. Are you also 
doing special training here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Nope. Not special training, just fishing~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The river fish from here makes for a truly 
buono acquapazza♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I go *smack* with my hands to knock out 
the swimming fishies~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. And then we just pick up the 
concussed fish afterwards to catch them, 
right!
choice_data_list: Is that even a way to catch fish?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Since they're knocked unconscious while 
still alive, they're bound to stay 
completely fresh and lively!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall join you next to it... and 
deliver a swift kick to those fish!
(SPLASH-THUD! SPLASH-CRASH!!)

Kawakami Princess and Hishi Akebono 
unleashed a barrage of attacks into the 
waterfall basin, knocking out and catching 
around ten fish.

The fish we caught... was prepared by 
Hishi Akebono, and the three of us enjoyed 
a delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You mean that passionate coaching episode 
from the original PreFai! Where the 
legendary trainer caught a fleeting 
glimpse of the Sanzu River during that 
hellish training, right?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh. A straw mat on the ocean? Why is 
something like that floating out 
there...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... King-san... Are you gonna challenge 
the floating mat dash too, King-san~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's special training where I splash and 
sprint across the sea... well, more 
accurately, across tatami mats floating on 
the water...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What kind of special training is that?! 
...S-So, is one of those two floating 
boards meant for me...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. That one is for Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll go borrow a straw mat for King-san 
from that beach hut right now! The trick 
to running is putting your left foot down 
before your right foot sinks...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! T-Then that's fine! You don't need to 
get me anything. More importantly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer looks like their soul is 
about to leave their body... Are they 
going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, I've only fallen 30 times 
so far, right, Trainer?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"This is the hellish mat-crossing we run 
through together! Let's give it our all 
with pure guts and grit until we cross the 
finish line!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A-Are you really going to be okay...?

And so, together with Kawakami Princess, 
we kept at the floating mat run until she 
finally made it across...
